notes.suite_2_decision: Fixed the check_emit_perline() predicate (not an allowlist entry, not a code change to orchestrate-triage-classify.sh). Rationale: (1) the write at line 225 is correct as written -- it must land in a real file because the caller consumes it via --slurpfile, so redirecting it to stdout would be wrong; (2) an allowlist entry naming this one line is narrower than the actual defect class -- any future `> "$var"` file-redirect write in any EMIT_PERLINE_FILES script would hit the same false positive, so allowlisting only this line leaves the predicate wrong; (3) fixing the predicate is the general fix and is verified not to over-suppress: the pre-existing EMIT case 2 (two genuine unredirected writes) and both negative controls remain unchanged after the fix (Phase 3 will add a dedicated regression case for this exact redirect shape).
